author: Gamers Nexus
description:
GRAB THE DISCS ON THE STORE! They will begin shipping by December 1. https://store.gamersnexus.net/
The AI companies have laid-out a clear plan: Watch everything you do, all the time, in perpetuity -- with Flock, that's done offline; with ChatGPT, Microsoft Windows, and NVIDIA's AI adventures, that's also done digitally. Meanwhile, the circular funding gets increasingly ridiculous as NVIDIA bankrolls everyone it can to keep the music going. The good news is that we can turn to Jim Cramer for salient, sane advice -- live in a data center, or something. The clowns are running the asylum.

Get our Blu-Ray version of factory tours, educational videos, engineering interviews, and special reports here: https://store.gamersnexus.net/products/gn-factory-tours-and-special-reports-blu-ray-discs-4k-case
And our Blu-Ray version of the AI GPU Black Market here: https://store.gamersnexus.net/products/blu-ray-ai-gpu-black-market-gamersnexus-movie-with-booklet
And finally, the Music CD for GN backing
title: There Are No Non-Clowns in the Clown Car
